dog.description_text:
This adorable pocket-sized girl may be small, but she has a big personality! At around 3 years old, she is full of energy, affection, and charm, not to mention the cutest big ears. Although she came to us as a stray, so we have limited information about her past, she seems to make friends with people quickly and loves sharing her affection. If you're looking for a little companion with lots of love and personality to give, this sweet girl could be the perfect match. Come meet her! â¤ï¸

My #BoroughBreak Buddy Writes: Ocean was an amazing dog for her first borough break. In the car ride home, she was a bit anxious but once we got home she decided to run into my backyard and play a bit. She wasn't too interested in her toys however she was very friendly and was running around with me. Once she was over it, she came into my house and she was sleeping in my sister's bed. She ended up taking a nap for a bit until we went for another car ride and dropped her back off. She was a fantastic dog and anyone who adopts her is adopting a massive cuddle bug. She wasn't too interested the absolute sweetest!
dog.name: Ocean
